run_eval_reranked: run the eval_reranked script to compute exact match and answer recall metrics on HotpotQA reranked results
review_eval_reranked: review the eval_reranked script that evaluates reranked retrieval chains against gold standard answers
summarize_eval_reranked: summarize the eval_reranked script which measures bridge and comparison passage exact match scores
refactor_eval_reranked: refactor the eval_reranked script to accept input file paths via command line arguments instead of hardcoded paths
test_eval_reranked: test the eval_reranked script by running it against a sample HotpotQA validation results JSON file
